best_human.provenance: The 2011 paper attributes the 95,242 heuristic result to Rodriguez-Tello et al. (2008). It is a traditional computational result; AI provenance is not stated.
best_human.evidence_state: reported in literature; original ordering not recovered or independently reproduced

best_public.evidence_state: published best-known heuristic value in the 2011 primary paper; ordering artifact unavailable in checked source package
best_public.origin_type: traditional heuristic search; AI provenance not reported

best_reproduced.provenance: Recomputed a Fiedler-vector spectral ordering on the official graph and applied strict-improvement adjacent-swap descent for at most 200 sweeps.
best_reproduced.ai_provenance: AI-assisted implementation and replay of a traditional published method. The 147,653 score is task-local and is not attributed to the source paper.
best_reproduced.evidence_state: ordering saved locally; exact permutation and all 1,676 edge lengths independently recomputed

frozen_human_baseline.type: reproduced traditional method; weaker than the reported 95,242 value

T045-C01.survey_scope_note: The 95,242 value is a literature report, not a replayed witness. The reproduced frozen reference is weaker. Current source checks are bounded and are not an exhaustive literature search.
